text: As artificial intelligence becomes part of our daily lives, ethical questions are more important than ever. AI systems can be biased if they are trained on unfair data, which may lead to unfair decisions about jobs, loans, or healthcare. They can also threaten our privacy by collecting and using personal information. For these reasons, fairness and transparency must be central to AI design. Companies and governments should explain how AI makes decisions and make sure it treats everyone equally. Responsible AI development means putting people first, protecting their rights, and building systems we can trust.
